description: List monitored checks with their current status and folder. Use for an overview, to find offline checks, or to see what is already monitored before creating duplicates. Pass folder to list one folder; add recursive to include its subfolders. Pass include="uptime" to add 24h and 30d uptime percentages and the 24h average response time to each check.

folder.description: Only checks in this folder, as a path like "Clients/Acme" (exact match unless recursive is true)

include.description: Set to "uptime" to add uptime24hPercent, uptime30dPercent and avgResponseTime24hMs to each check (null when unavailable)

recursive.description: With folder, also include checks in its subfolders (default false)

name: list_checks
title: List checks
